text: 证监会发布关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见。优化证券发行准入监管。严把房地产开发企业证券发行入口关，突出“基于项目”融资特点。上市房地产开发企业再融资的，重点关注其资金管理、拿地拍地、项目建设销售等内部控制制度是否健全有效，以及项目开发、注册资本缴纳、企业资质等是否合法合规。发行股份、定向可转债购买涉房资产的，重点关注标的资产业务开展是否合法合规、估值定价是否合理公允，以及本次重组是否有利于提高上市公司质量等。房地产开发企业发行公司债券的，重点关注募投房地产项目合规性、收益性、资金需求合理性。发行ABS的，重点关注基础资产权属状况、现金流持续稳
text_en: The CSRC issued opinions on supporting the establishment of a new model for real estate development through the capital market. Optimize securities issuance access regulation. Strictly control the entry point for securities issuance by real estate development companies, highlighting the project-based financing feature. For refinancing by listed real estate development companies, focus on whether their internal control systems for fund management, land acquisition and bidding, project construction and sales are sound and effective, and whether project development, registered capital payment, and corporate qualifications are legal and compliant. For issuing shares or targeted convertible bonds to purchase real estate-related assets, focus on whether the target asset business is legal and compliant, whether valuation and pricing are reasonable and fair, and whether the restructuring is conducive to improving the quality of the listed company. For real estate development companies issuing corporate bonds, focus on the compliance, profitability, and reasonableness of fund needs of the raised-investment real estate projects. For issuing ABS, focus on the ownership status of underlying assets, stable and continuous cash flows
